standard_prerequisites.name: Comparison of periodic lengths and the multiplication formula
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, labels lemma-compare-periodic-lengths (proof line 1195), lemma-multiply-period-length (proof line 1218), lemma-powers-period-length-zero (proof line 1225) and lemma-length-multiplication (proof lines 1227, 1241, 1257)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the vanishing of the sum of the e_A(M_i, a, b) into the statement about orders, and supplies the term by term identities used in the computation; the computation itself is inside the counted span.

core_obligations: Reduce to the case where for each height one prime q_i the elements a and b are, up to units, powers of a single nonzerodivisor: apply the preparation lemma at each q_i, then the key extension lemma with t = ab to obtain one finite local extension A inside B inside which all the B_i occur, and use norm compatibility of the tame symbol to see the sum is unchanged (proof lines 1146-1169).

Show that the sum of the e_A(M_i, a, b) vanishes, where M_i is the image of A/(ab) in A_{q_i}/(ab): the map A/(ab) -> direct sum of the M_i has kernel and cokernel supported at the maximal ideal, hence of finite length, so the comparison lemma for periodic lengths applies (proof lines 1171-1197).

Compute e_A(M_i, a, b) = - ord_{A/q_i}(partial(a, b)) when pi_i, u_i, v_i lift from the localisation: expand the length via the multiplication formula, observe that the three resulting terms come from the zero-period-length lemma and from the length-multiplication lemma, and read off the equality from multiplicativity of the order function (proof lines 1199-1229).

Remove the lifting hypothesis by clearing denominators of pi_i, u_i and v_i with elements c outside q_i, tracking how e_A(M_i, ca, cb) and the tame symbol change under that multiplication, which reduces to two further identities supplied by the length-multiplication lemma (proof lines 1231-1259).
proof_roadmap: Replace A by a finite local extension in which each localised tame symbol is prepared, using norm compatibility to keep the sum (proof lines 1146-1169).
Compare the sum of the local periodic lengths with the sum of the M_i through the comparison lemma, reducing to one identity per prime (proof lines 1171-1197).
Prove that identity by the multiplication formula when the local data lift, then clear denominators to get the general case (proof lines 1199-1259).
difficulty_reason: The lemma says that for a two-dimensional Noetherian local ring A and nonzerodivisors a, b, the sum of the orders at the height one primes of the tame symbols partial_{A_q}(a, b) is zero (statement lines 1132-1144, tag 0EAW). The proof is a multi-stage reduction: the preparation of the tame symbol together with the key extension lemma replaces A by a finite local extension, the map from A/(ab) into the direct sum of the localised images is shown to have finite length kernel and cokernel so a comparison of periodic lengths applies, and the remaining identity is computed by the multiplication formula after clearing denominators of the local coordinates. Each step is a specific algebraic construction, not a citation, so the claim is H2.
